text: その　ジムバッジ……　すげえな　タケシに　かったのかよ！

structure.jp: タケシに　かったのかよ！

patterns.name: 〜に勝つ
patterns.explanation: With かつ, the one you beat takes に, not を. タケシに　かった = 'beat Brock'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか after a verb asks for confirmation of something just noticed, and よ makes it rough and amazed. かったのかよ = 'you really won?!'

patterns.name: 〜な (exclamation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker's own feeling of being struck by something. すげえ is a rough way to say すごい. すげえな = 'wow, awesome'.
